name: The Vibe Company
long_description:
The Vibe Company (formerly Quivr, YC W24) is an AI-native agency. We build custom products and internal tools for companies, deploy agentic automations (agents, skills, workflows), and train teams on AI adoption.

Our bet: agencies don’t scale because they sell hours. We’re building one that does, by automating our own internal processes with AI agents. Every workflow we automate for ourselves becomes something we can ship to clients.
one_liner: AI-native agency that scales like software, run on our own AI agents.
